start.title: [TODO:ar] A Voice in Sleep
start.text:
[TODO:ar] An angel speaks in your dream:
"Rise. Herod seeks the child."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sleep on, it is only a dream

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your eyes open in the dark.
[TODO:ar] There is no time to wait.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Rise Now
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The danger is real and near.
Do not delay.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Trust the Word
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Heaven has already spoken.
Move now.

wake.title: [TODO:ar] Wake the Mother
wake.text:
[TODO:ar] Mary sleeps with the child near.
There is no time to lose.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wake Mary and prepare to flee
[TODO:ar] Hide the child in the house

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Flee, Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The angel said to leave the land.
Obey the word.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wake Mary and prepare to flee

flee.title: [TODO:ar] Out of Bethlehem
flee.text:
[TODO:ar] Moonlight falls on empty streets.
The child sleeps in Mary's arms.

warn_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Go Quietly
warn_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your task is to save the child.
Leave at once.

main_road_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Hidden Paths
main_road_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Soldiers patrol the open ways.
Keep to the shadows.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You take the small back paths.

road.title: [TODO:ar] Toward the South
road.text:
[TODO:ar] The desert stretches before you.
Egypt lies far beyond.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Turn back, the road is too far

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Forward Only
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Behind you is danger.
Ahead is safety.

rest.title: [TODO:ar] By the Oasis
rest.text:
[TODO:ar] Water glints under the rising sun.
The child must drink.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You go together or not at all.

linger_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Move On
linger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The border is still far away.
Keep going.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You fill your skins and rise.

send_back_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay Together
send_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] She and the child are your charge.
Never leave them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You take her hand and walk on.

egypt.title: [TODO:ar] The Land of Egypt
egypt.text:
[TODO:ar] Pyramids rise in the rose dawn.
You have crossed the border.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Find a humble home and stay
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A small door opens to you.

court_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay Hidden
court_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The child must grow in quiet.
Find a humble place.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Find a humble home and stay
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You knock at a small house.

safe.title: [TODO:ar] Safe in Egypt
safe.text:
[TODO:ar] The child sleeps under a warm lamp.
He is alive. He is safe.
